properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Access token expiration time in milliseconds. Default: 24 hours

properties.name: jwt.header-name
properties.description: Header name for JWT token. Default: "Authorization"

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token expiration time in milliseconds. Default: 7 days

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens. Must be at least 256 bits (32 characters) for HS256 algorithm.

properties.name: jwt.token-prefix
properties.description: Token prefix in Authorization header. Default: "Bearer "
